description:
Start a real Gage project from a quote, so the person can get their building fabricated: Gage creates their project with the regional fabricator that priced it and emails them a private link to it. From that page they review the quote, talk to the fabricator and follow the frame to delivery. Nothing is charged by starting a project.

Only call this when the person has said they want to go ahead, and only with a name and email address they have given you for this. Ask them first: "Shall I send this to Gage so a fabricator can take it on? I'll need your name and email." Set person_agreed to true only after they say yes.

Use the quote_id from quote_my_building or submit_design_for_quote. The link goes to their email only; tell them to look for an email from Gage. How Gage handles their details: https://buildwithgage.com/privacy.

email.description: The person's email address, as they gave it. Their project link is sent here.

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it.

person_agreed.description: True only once the person has agreed to send their details to Gage to start the project.

phone.description: Phone number, if they offered one.

project_name.description: A short name for the project, e.g. "Lakeside cabin".

quote_id.description: The quote to build from, from quote_my_building or submit_design_for_quote.

name: start_my_project
title: Start a Gage project
